description: License exceptions for Retenia dependencies. Add entries to "exceptions" as "<package-name>": "<reason; link to the decision if applicable>" (a trailing "*" covers a family of platform-specific packages that share one license decision) for packages whose license is acceptable but does not fit the allowlist in check-licenses.mjs.

exceptions.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk*: Proprietary (Anthropic's own commercial CLI terms, https://code.claude.com/docs/en/legal-and-compliance) — an *optional* dependency of promptfoo (tooling/evals, sub-phase 7.5) for a redteam/agentic feature our promptfooconfig.yaml never invokes; we only drive `promptfoo eval` with a custom provider. It is confined to `tooling/evals`'s devDependencies, never a dependency of `apps/desktop`, so electron-builder never packages it — no end user's install ever contains it. Flagged for a second look rather than silently allowed: it is the one exception here that is not open source. One entry for the package and its per-platform binary (`@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64`), the same reasoning `@img/sharp-*` already uses for a platform-split family.
exceptions.@csstools/color-helpers: MIT-0 (MIT with the attribution clause removed) — strictly more permissive than MIT; transitive dep of Tailwind 4/lightningcss.
exceptions.@csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree: MIT-0 (MIT with the attribution clause removed) — strictly more permissive than MIT; transitive dep of Tailwind 4/lightningcss.
exceptions.@img/sharp-*: LGPL-3.0-or-later (with Apache-2.0 and MIT parts, depending on the variant) — libvips, shipped as an unmodified prebuilt shared library that sharp loads dynamically, which is the arrangement LGPL §4 exists for; we neither modify it nor link it statically. One entry for the whole `@img/sharp-*` family because it is one decision and the packages differ only by platform: Linux and macOS split the library out into `@img/sharp-libvips-<platform>`, Windows bundles it inside `@img/sharp-win32-<arch>`, and which of them is installed depends on the machine running this check. It all arrives as a transitive dependency of @huggingface/transformers (packages/ingest, sub-phase 6.3), whose image pipelines Retenia never uses — we embed and rerank text only — so it is dead weight in the installer rather than a component of the app.
exceptions.binaryextensions: Artistic-2.0 — OSI-approved; transitive dep of promptfoo (tooling/evals, sub-phase 7.5) via istextorbinary, dev-only.
exceptions.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 — attribution-only browser support data, not code; transitive dep of browserslist (Vite/PostCSS toolchain).
exceptions.chownr: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.duck: BSD (the bundled LICENSE file is the plain two-clause BSD text, i.e. BSD-2-Clause, just not spelled as that exact SPDX id in package.json) — transitive dep of mammoth's parser-combinator library (lop), sub-phase 6.1.
